name: revier
description: A local Git code review assistant built with Electron, Vue, and TypeScript.
author: uheee

scripts.dist:win: pwsh -NoLogo -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build.ps1 -PrepareIconsOnly && pnpm build && pnpm dlx --allow-build=electron-winstaller electron-builder@26.15.1 --win msi --x64 --publish=never
scripts.dist:linux: bash scripts/build.sh --platform linux --arch x64 --prepare-icons-only && pnpm build && pnpm dlx --allow-build=electron-winstaller electron-builder@26.15.1 --linux deb rpm --x64 --publish=never
scripts.dist:mac: bash scripts/build.sh --platform mac --universal --prepare-icons-only && pnpm build && pnpm dlx --allow-build=electron-winstaller electron-builder@26.15.1 --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish=never
scripts.rust:spike: node scripts/cargo-duckdb-download.mjs run -p revier-analysis -- spike run
scripts.rust:index:status: node scripts/cargo-duckdb-download.mjs run -p revier-analysis -- index status
scripts.rust:index:build: node scripts/cargo-duckdb-download.mjs run -p revier-analysis -- index build
scripts.rust:index:query-files: node scripts/cargo-duckdb-download.mjs run -p revier-analysis -- index query-files
